title: 15 eggless flavours beyond vanilla for Rouse Hill and Riverstone birthdays
summary:
Vanilla and chocolate are the safe choice. They are not the only choice.

Fifteen flavours are on the menu at Riverstone, including Rasmalai and Ferrero Rocher — the two flavours that make people ask who baked the cake, not just whose birthday it was. All 100% eggless, the same as everything else we make.

Custom design, six sizes, buttercream, fondant, or ganache. 48 hours minimum notice — that's what fresh baking actually takes.

Order via WhatsApp: +61 425 697 725. Pickup from Riverstone Shopping Centre, free parking included. Rouse Hill and Schofields families, that's a short drive for a cake nobody forgets.
